about: One round that checks, in the game, the tools that were written offline against the official samples. Walking right along the strip: (1) a coin with a follow device flies to the player once inside its wide trigger and is picked up by its narrow one: CK_PULL then CK_COIN; (2) a post gets a green outline while the player is near it and loses it when the player leaves: CK_GLOW_ON, CK_GLOW_OFF, and it has a minimap marker; (3) a stall has two options, 开门 behind a boolean filter (shown only once the player holds the key the coin gives) and 没有钥匙 always shown: choosing 开门 prints CK_OPEN and starts the gate's motion, the gate should rise 4 m in 2 s; (4) twelve seconds in the stage switches every player to the night sky (CK_NIGHT) and at twenty-two back (CK_DAY); a lamp above the post belongs to the night sky and should be lit only then. (6) when night falls the stage also sends the signal CK_dusk and the post, which only listens, prints CK_HEARD and the string the signal carries (night); (9) nobody is teleported: the spawn point puts the player at x = -3 facing +z, and CK_AT prints that x two seconds in; the gate is created at a preset point read by the graph, so it should stand right of the stall as before; (8) the post owns an attack ability unit and stings whoever walks up to it (CK_STING): the health bar at the bottom should drop from 10000 by about 3000; (7) a thirty-second countdown held by the stage starts at CK_GO, shows as a clock at the top of the screen and prints CK_TIME_UP when it ends; (5) the class has jumping switched off: space is pressed at second 4 and the character should stay on the ground in the shots of seconds 4 and 5; if it jumps, the order of the four class switches is not the one assumed. (10) money: the currency CK_gold is defined and every character starts with 7 of it in a backpack; two seconds in the stage prints CK_PURSE and the amount (7), then adds 5, and the character graph, which hears the amount change, prints CK_MONEY and the new amount (12). (11) preset status: a chest (asset 10005006) stands left of the post, closed; when night falls at second 12 the stage sets its preset status to 1 and prints CK_CHEST and the value read back (1): the chest should be shut in the shot of second 11 and open in the shot of second 13. (12) path motion: a wooden platform (asset 10005015) behind the lane goes up three metres and down again for ever, two seconds each way, from the moment it appears; at second 12 the stage prints CK_LIFT and its height, which should be near 3 (0 means it never moved), and the shots should show it at different heights. (13) skill: an instant skill CK_ping is given to the character on the E key two seconds in; E is pressed at second 8.5, its client graph notifies the server and the character graph prints CK_SKILL and the word CK_ping. (14) a filter that is false: a second stall stands at the start, where the player has no key; F there at second 2 should print CK_LOCKED (the filtered option hidden, the other one picked), not CK_OPEN. (15) no jumping: CK_Y prints the character's height eleven times around the press of space; it should not rise. Look at the screenshots for: the coin moving, the outline, the marker on the minimap, which options show, the gate up, the dark sky.
